display_long_description:
* Support for 'Featured Media' ended (Dec, 2020)

Samsung Internet for Gear VR lets you browse the web and enjoy contents in an immersive environment.

[Supported Features]
* Secret Mode : More private browsing experience with PIN number protection.
* Content Blockers : Free your web pages from unnecessary content
* Gear VR Controller Support
* Mirroring with TV : Mirrors the screen image of Samsung Internet for Gear VR to your TV
* Integration with Samsung Internet for Android (v.4.0 and above): Connect Gear VR to your mobile device with any web page or fullscreen video open on Samsung Internet for Android, to continuously view them in VR
* Quick Access, Bookmarks and Video History
* File Explorer : Connect your USB storage using USB OTG (SM-R323, R324, R325)
* Skybox Setting : Set the skybox in the 'Change background' menu and the custom skybox by JS API
* Supported type of video : 180˚, 360˚ etc.
